app.name: Escrowd
app.tagline: A drawing made for you — agreed from the start
app.footer: Escrowd — deposit starts work. Balance unlocks the file.

home.title: A drawing made for you. Not a week of DMs.
home.subtitle: Tell Nour what to draw, see the price, and pay a deposit on Paymob. She starts when the money is confirmed. The finished file unlocks after the balance — so both of you are covered.
home.step1Body: Fill what to draw. Pay the deposit on Paymob. Nour does not start until that payment is confirmed.
home.step2Body: You get a secret link — status and preview live there, not in DMs.
home.step3Body: The finished file appears only after the balance. Until then it stays in the studio.
home.aboutTitle: Nour draws. Escrowd holds the money.
home.aboutLead: Garden City, Cairo. Portraits, characters, marks. One Instagram link instead of a week of DMs about price, scope, and when the file is coming.
home.aboutBody: A deposit starts the drawing. The brief freezes with that payment. The finished file stays in the studio until the balance lands on Paymob. Clients have no account — just a page they can return to.
home.workNote: Recent pieces from the Garden City studio. Same hand as a commission.
home.closeBody: One form. A live price. Deposit starts work; the balance unlocks the file.

commission.title: Tell Nour what to draw.
commission.subtitle: The live price is display only. The server recomputes it, freezes the brief, then sends you to Paymob hosted checkout.
commission.name: Name
commission.phoneHint: Egyptian mobile (010, 011, 012, or 015). Paymob uses this on checkout.
commission.subjectsHint: People or characters in the drawing — 1 to 8.
commission.priceNote: Display only. The server recomputes and freezes this before Paymob.
commission.commercialNote: Commercial usage multiplies the price ×3. That is what the brief freezes.
commission.submit: Lock the brief and pay the deposit
commission.invalidName: Enter a name of at least two letters.
commission.invalidBrief: The brief is not valid. Refresh and try again.

order.confirmingBody: Returning from Paymob is not proof of payment. We wait for the signed webhook.
order.awaitingBalance: Pay the balance to unlock the file
order.hiddenFinal: The final file appears after the balance is paid.
order.trouble: Having trouble loading status. Keep this page — payment is confirmed only by the signed webhook.
order.windowRule: Pay the deposit within 72 hours of locking the brief. After that the payment rating is 4 stars, not 5. You can still pay.
order.windowOpen: Pay within {hours}h {minutes}m for a 5-star rating. After 72 hours it becomes 4 stars. You can still pay.
order.windowClosed: 72 hours passed without a verified deposit. This commission is 4 stars, not 5. You can still pay.

dashboard.title: Commissions
dashboard.overviewSubtitle: Paid totals follow the verified webhook. These charts read the same orders table — nothing is marked paid from here.
dashboard.boardSubtitle: One column per status. You move the work; Paymob moves paid.
dashboard.subtitle: Paid only after a verified webhook. You move the work. Deposit starts it; balance unlocks the file.
dashboard.loadError: Could not load commissions. Refresh the page.
dashboard.advancePreview: Upload preview and send to review
dashboard.advanceFinal: Upload final and request the balance
dashboard.fileHint: PNG, JPEG, or WebP. 8 MB max.
dashboard.ordersHint: Every brief that created a row.
dashboard.needsNourHint: Preview or final still to upload.
dashboard.escrowedHint: Deposits in, balance not yet paid.
dashboard.pipelineCaption: Orders by status · source: orders table
dashboard.activityCaption: Cairo calendar days · opened vs webhook-verified payments
dashboard.byTypeCaption: Commission value by brief type · source: orders table
dashboard.noFinal: Final is hidden from the client until the balance is paid.
dashboard.ratingLate: Deposit was not verified within 72 hours of the brief — 4 stars instead of 5.
